verses.en: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.pt: Senhor, o meu coração não é soberbo, nem os meus olhos são altivos; não me ocupo de assuntos grandes e maravilhosos demais para mim.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, my heart isn’t haughty, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up. Of David.> Lord, there is no pride in my heart and my eyes are not lifted up; and I have not taken part in great undertakings, or in things over-hard for me.

verses.en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.pt: Pelo contrário, tenho feito acalmar e sossegar a minha alma; qual criança desmamada sobre o seio de sua mãe, qual criança desmamada está a minha alma para comigo.
verses.en_web: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.en_bbe: See, I have made my soul calm and quiet, like a child on its mother's breast; my soul is like a child on its mother's breast.

verses.en: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
verses.pt: Espera, ó Israel, no Senhor, desde agora e para sempre.
verses.en_web: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.en_bbe: O Israel, have hope in the Lord, from this time and for ever.
